messages.subject: Re: [dublin-r] Next Meeting
parts:
Firstly, this user group is in its infancy, so I would suggest the focus for the next few months would be to develop it.
As to how to go about this, we can all give our views at the meeting.  

Seeking advice from members of the Python Ireland group,  they suggested a series of regular (i.e. monthly ) meetingsto start of with, even it it just two or three people attending.

I reckon that this next meeting wont go on long - at most an hour.

In the last meeting during the summer, we discussed organizing formal talks.I reckon we should try to get ourselves to this stage as soon as possible. That is something we can discuss at the meeting.

Regards

Kevin O'Brien
